description: This Java class `CloseConnectionResponse` represents the response to a `CloseConnection` command within a connectivity command module. It provides methods to create instances from parameters or JSON, retrieve associated connection IDs, and handle JSON serialization/deserialization. The class is immutable and extends a base command response class, indicating it is part of a larger command-response framework in a connectivity management system.
